metadata.note: Progress update on the week of 2026-11-23 — the second of the week's two videos. Toolkit-only patterns (ClaudeComposerAsk, ReelExecSummary, ReelFramework, BlipLadder, ClaudeVerdictArtifact, ClaudeTitleOutro). 16:9 only — weekly progress updates ship in landscape alone; the week's explainer carries the 9:16 cut. Every figure comes from this week's explainer build (fact check, PROOF-REVIEW.md, measured audio, clip check, GATE V) or the lab post it teaches.
